semiconductor_relevance: Medium — while primarily focused on pneumatic components, their products are applicable in automation processes within semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shanghai Chelic Pneumatic Co., Ltd specializes in manufacturing pneumatic and electric actuator automation components, which are utilized in various machinery sectors, including factory automation and inspection equipment. Their products aim to enhance production efficiency and reduce manufacturing costs, making them relevant to the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company has its headquarters in New Taipei City and a manufacturing site in Taiwan.
regional_presence.China: Chelic operates a manufacturing facility in Shanghai.
